pinnedReasons.startup-deadline: Must pass before the job starts local Supabase.
pinnedReasons.browser-deps: Must pass before the Android lane provisions pinned browsers.
pinnedReasons.worklets-staging: Needs the generated Android project, so it runs after prebuild.
pinnedReasons.share-card-plugins: apps/mobile/plugins also holds the watchOS and widget prebuild suites that other workflows own, so these two are listed instead of discovered.
pinnedReasons.vitest: Imports vitest, so node --test cannot run it; the vitest step gates it from its JSON report.
